verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents outbound webhooks a programmatic consumer can receive. You can set up webhooks by event type (e.g. `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`) with structured payloads such as `screening_result`, and every delivery carries a `webhook-id` header for idempotency. Signing is available as an opt-in per account. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, explicit registration mechanics (API/UI endpoint for subscribing), retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
